framework: Aligned with the NIST AI RMF 1.0 functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage). Not a certification or compliance claim.
status: Agent-proposed register (2026-10-15). Owners are proposed from the launcher responsibility matrix; likelihood and severity are the agent's initial assessment. Every entry awaits human review; no human decision is recorded in this file.

scales.score: likelihood x severity; 15+ high, 8-14 medium, below 8 low

risks.title: A student in crisis is not routed to urgent guidance
risks.description: Keyword routing misses non-English, implicit or unusually phrased crisis messages.
risks.mitigation_plan: SB-04/05/06 mitigated in Phase 5. Finalization (2026-10-15): escalate-only explicit crisis lexicon for 12 languages, narrow implicit-risk warning signs, and an unsupported-language notice with 988/911; the SB-07 and SB-08 scenarios now pass and the pre-registered probes give 34/34 and 15/15 with 0/30 benign escalations. Still open: languages outside the lexicon (0/4 probes routed; notice only), implicit wording outside the lists, and every term is agent-drafted. Needs Devika's routing review, native-speaker and clinical review, and a human residual-risk decision.
pending_human_review: SB-07 multilingual crisis lexicon (agent-drafted; Devika's routing review and native-speaker review)
SB-08 implicit-risk warning-sign lists (agent-drafted; Devika's routing review and clinical review)
language_support notice wording, including its Spanish sentence

risks.title: Safety guidance is replaced or weakened by a model, planner or decline handling
risks.description: Downstream components could override a deterministic safety decision.
risks.mitigation_plan: Keep the safety stage first; keep parity and red-team safety scenarios in the release gate.

risks.title: Prompt injection causes unauthorized actions
risks.description: User text, model output or retrieved text tries to invoke privileged operations.
risks.mitigation_plan: No privileged agent tools; agent channel denied admin:*; red-team class prompt_injection 0/9.

risks.title: Poisoned or unreviewed content reaches answers
risks.description: Malicious or unreviewed pages become citations; until 2026-10-15 the C1 CLI path read KB files directly (RP-06).
risks.mitigation_plan: Governed API blocks it (retrieval poisoning 0/6). Finalization (2026-10-15): the CLI/Dispatcher path ranks only records the inventory lists with the same content hash and an eligible status, without instruction-like content, and fails closed; legacy red team RP-06 defended. Host and freshness checks stay API-only. The CLI behaviour change needs human acceptance.
pending_human_review: RP-06 legacy CLI retrieval gate (a behaviour change for the C1 CLI path)

risks.title: Outdated or unreviewed campus information
risks.description: All 7 citable KB records are baseline (no governed review) and dated 2025; hours and services may have changed.
risks.mitigation_plan: A reviewer checks each source against the official page and records approve/reject in the staff UI; stale notices are shown until then.

risks.title: One student sees or changes another's conversation
risks.description: Broken ownership checks would disclose sensitive conversations.

risks.title: Staff account takeover or privilege escalation
risks.description: Guessing, CSRF, session reuse or forged roles grant administrative capability.
risks.mitigation_plan: No MFA in this local prototype (documented). Red-team privilege_escalation 0/9.

risks.title: Sensitive text in logs, traces or audit records
risks.description: Conversation text or identities leak into operational records.
risks.mitigation_plan: Phase 7 adds structured logs and traces with the same rule (no message text, no arguments, hashed principals).

risks.title: Invented contact details or campus guidance
risks.description: Generated or retrieved text presents unverified phone numbers, hours or clinical advice as fact.
risks.mitigation_plan: No generated prose in answers; fake-number scenarios RP-02, RP-03, PI-09 defended.

risks.title: Model provider outage or slowness degrades the service
risks.description: Hung or failing model calls consume threads or delay answers (C1 deferral O9).
risks.mitigation_plan: Model features off by default; breaker and in-flight bound in place; Phase 8 resilience tests in containers.

risks.title: Vulnerable third-party dependencies
risks.description: Known vulnerabilities in Python or npm packages.
risks.mitigation_plan: Rerun pip-audit and npm audit in every release-readiness run.

risks.title: Users mistake the prototype for an official or clinical service
risks.description: Students may rely on it for clinical or emergency help.
risks.mitigation_plan: Keep the disclaimer on every view; synthetic data only; no public deployment.

risks.title: Server-side request forgery through ingestion
risks.description: An attacker-chosen URL reaches internal services.
risks.mitigation_plan: Admin-only; allowlist and address checks; rebinding detection depends on the HTTP stack.

risks.title: Contracts and governance decisions not accepted by both humans
risks.description: Local-first decisions (workflow, contracts, policies, thresholds) were made in one operator's session and await recorded acceptance.
risks.mitigation_plan: Both humans review the awaiting-acceptance list in docs/phase-status.json before publication.

risks.title: Single-process limits on abuse controls and availability
risks.description: Rate limits and caches are in-memory per process; restarts reset them.
risks.mitigation_plan: Run one backend replica (Compose and kind manifests set replicas: 1 for the API) and document it.
